instruction: You are facing towards the door, turn around and move towards the piano. Turn slight right move in the path till you reach the chairs to your right. Turn slight right and move forward. Turn right and enter into the kitchen area. Turn slight right and move in between the 2 platforms. You are facing towards the sink, turn slight right and pass through the open arch. Take few steps ahead. Turn slight left and move towards the curtain. You are facing towards the curtain, which is your final destination.
